name: Elvis Presley

pageEyebrow.zh: 关键人物 · 根源与摇滚乐

whyMatters.en: Presley is one of the key figures through whom 1950s rock’n’roll entered US mainstream pop culture. Early records came from Sun in Memphis; after the 1955 move to RCA, national distribution and TV exposure grew. In 1954–58, Scotty Moore, Bill Black, and D.J. Fontana were his closest early collaborators. This site files him as a person node (singer/actor), not as a band named Elvis.
whyMatters.zh: Presley 是 1950 年代摇滚乐进入美国主流流行文化的重要人物之一。他的早期录音来自孟菲斯 Sun Records；1955 年转入 RCA 后，唱片发行和全国电视曝光进一步扩大。1954–58 年间，Scotty Moore、Bill Black 和 D.J. Fontana 是与他合作最密切的早期乐手。本站将其作为歌手／演员人物节点收录，而非一支名为 Elvis 的乐队。

note.en: Sun Records session: Presley sings and plays guitar; Scotty Moore on electric guitar; Bill Black on bass.
note.zh: Sun Records 录音。Presley 演唱并弹吉他，Scotty Moore 弹电吉他，Bill Black 演奏贝斯。

note.en: RCA single. Presley’s cut followed Freddie Bell and the Bellboys’ rewrite more than a direct copy of Big Mama Thornton; national TV (Milton Berle, Ed Sullivan) widened its reach.
note.zh: RCA 单曲。Presley 的版本受到 Freddie Bell and the Bellboys 演出版本影响，并通过电视演出获得全国性曝光。

shortBio.en: American singer and actor. 1954 Sun sessions in Memphis with Scotty Moore and Bill Black; RCA from late 1955; national hits in 1956.
shortBio.zh: 美国歌手、演员。1954 年孟菲斯 Sun 录音，配 Scotty Moore 与 Bill Black；1955 年底转 RCA；1956 年进入全国流行市场。

body.en:
In 1954 Presley began recording at Sun Records in Memphis. Scotty Moore and Bill Black played on the earliest sessions and shows; D.J. Fontana joined later. In late 1955 his contract moved to RCA; in 1956 Heartbreak Hotel, Hound Dog and related singles made him a national pop singer.

This page treats him as a singer with a working band, not as a group named “Elvis.” The early lineup focus is 1954–58 with Moore, Black, and Fontana—not the later TCB Band (1969).
body.zh:
1954 年，Presley 在孟菲斯 Sun Records 开始录音。Scotty Moore 和 Bill Black 参与了最早的录音与演出，D.J. Fontana 随后加入。1955 年底，Presley 的合约转至 RCA；1956 年，他凭借《Heartbreak Hotel》《Hound Dog》等作品成为全国性的流行歌手。

本页按歌手与合作乐手来写，而不是一支名为「Elvis」的固定乐队。早期阵容聚焦 1954–58 的 Moore、Black 与 Fontana——不是 1969 年才成立的 TCB Band。

title.en: From Memphis to a national audience

body.en:
The 1954 Sun sessions were mainly a Memphis story. Presley then widened his audience through Southern tours, radio, and record releases.

After RCA bought his contract in 1955, distribution scaled up. In 1956 Heartbreak Hotel was his first RCA single and a key step into the national pop market.

This site’s early lineup record centers on Presley, Scotty Moore, Bill Black, and D.J. Fontana. Moore, Black, and Fontana still worked with him in the late 1950s; Moore and Black left in 1958.
body.zh:
1954 年的 Sun 录音主要发生在孟菲斯。随后，Presley 通过南方巡演、广播节目和唱片发行逐渐扩大听众范围。

1955 年 RCA 买下他的合约后，他的唱片发行规模进一步扩大。1956 年，《Heartbreak Hotel》成为他的首支 RCA 单曲，也是他进入全国流行市场的重要节点。

本站的早期阵容记录以 Presley、Scotty Moore、Bill Black 和 D.J. Fontana 为主。Moore、Black 和 Fontana 在 1950 年代后期仍与 Presley 一起演出和录音，Moore 和 Black 于 1958 年离开。

body.en:
That’s All Right (1954) comes from blues singer Arthur “Big Boy” Crudup.

On Sun’s first formal session, Presley sang and played guitar, Scotty Moore played electric guitar, and Bill Black played bass. After the cut, Sun issued the single; Memphis DJ Dewey Phillips played it, and local attention followed quickly.

The other side was Bill Monroe’s Blue Moon of Kentucky. Together the two sides show early Presley using both blues and country material.
body.zh:
《That’s All Right》（1954）原作来自蓝调歌手 Arthur “Big Boy” Crudup。

在 Sun 的第一次正式录音中，Presley 演唱并弹吉他，Scotty Moore 弹电吉他，Bill Black 演奏贝斯。录音完成后，Sun 将其发行；孟菲斯电台 DJ Dewey Phillips 播放了这首歌，使它很快获得当地听众的注意。

同一时期发行的另一面是 Bill Monroe 的《Blue Moon of Kentucky》。这两首歌放在一起，可以看出 Presley 早期作品同时使用了 blues 与 country 的材料。

alt.en: Elvis Presley with guitarist Scotty Moore
alt.zh: Elvis Presley 与吉他手 Scotty Moore

body.en:
Hound Dog was first recorded by Big Mama Thornton in 1952. The version Presley used in 1956 was shaped by Freddie Bell and the Bellboys’ rewritten live arrangement in Las Vegas—not a straight lift of Thornton’s record alone.

In June 1956 he performed it on The Milton Berle Show, then repeatedly on The Ed Sullivan Show. The first Sullivan appearance on 9 September 1956 was reported to draw about 60 million viewers. The 6 January 1957 Sullivan broadcast, shot from the waist up, became a well-known case of TV framing and censorship.
body.zh:
《Hound Dog》最早由 Big Mama Thornton 于 1952 年录制。Presley 在 1956 年采用的版本，则受到 Freddie Bell and the Bellboys 在拉斯维加斯演出的改写版本影响。

1956 年 6 月，Presley 在《The Milton Berle Show》演出《Hound Dog》，随后又在《The Ed Sullivan Show》的多次节目中演出这首歌。

其中 1956 年 9 月 9 日的首次《Ed Sullivan Show》演出，据当时统计吸引约 6000 万名观众观看。1957 年 1 月 6 日的最后一次演出则因电视摄影只拍摄他的上半身而成为著名的电视审查案例。

alt.en: Elvis Presley with Ed Sullivan, October 1956
alt.zh: Elvis Presley 与 Ed Sullivan，1956 年 10 月

body.en:
In the 1950s Presley did not tour as a fixed act called “the Elvis band.” He worked as a singer with regular session and road players.

The three most important early musicians were Scotty Moore (guitar), Bill Black (bass), and D.J. Fontana (drums). They worked with him from the early Sun period into around 1958 and are central to his early sound.

That early lineup is not the TCB Band. The TCB Band formed in 1969 after Presley returned to live performance, and should not be mixed into the 1954–58 roster.
body.zh:
1950 年代的 Presley 并不是以一支固定名称的「Elvis 乐队」活动，而是以歌手身份与固定合作乐手共同录音和巡演。

早期最重要的三位乐手是 Scotty Moore、Bill Black 和 D.J. Fontana。Moore 负责吉他，Black 负责贝斯，Fontana 负责鼓。他们从早期 Sun 录音一直合作到 1958 年前后，是 Presley 早期声音的重要组成部分。

这支早期阵容与后来的 TCB Band 不是同一支乐队。TCB Band 成立于 1969 年 Presley 重返现场演出之后，因此不应与 1954–58 年的阵容混在一起。

alt.en: Elvis Presley with band, TV Radio Mirror, September 1956
alt.zh: Elvis Presley 与乐队，《TV Radio Mirror》1956 年 9 月

body.en:
National fame did not come from records alone.

In 1956 he appeared on Stage Show, The Milton Berle Show, The Steve Allen Show, and The Ed Sullivan Show. Records, tours, and television together expanded his public reach.

For the music of this period, the Sun sides and 1950s RCA singles are the direct evidence. Television adds another layer: stage moves, band setup, and how the act looked on camera.
body.zh:
Presley 的全国知名度并不只来自唱片。

1956 年，他先后出现在《Stage Show》《The Milton Berle Show》《The Steve Allen Show》和《The Ed Sullivan Show》等电视节目中。唱片、巡演和电视演出共同扩大了他的公众影响力。

对于这一时期的音乐，Sun 录音以及 1950 年代的 RCA 单曲是更直接的材料。电视节目则提供了另一种信息：观众可以看到他的舞台动作、乐队编制和当时的表演方式。

alt.en: Elvis Presley at the Olympia Theater, Miami, 3 August 1956
alt.zh: Elvis Presley 在迈阿密 Olympia Theater，1956 年 8 月 3 日

note.en: Recorded July 1954 at Sun in Memphis: Presley singing Crudup’s blues song, Scotty Moore on electric guitar, Bill Black on bass.
note.zh: 《That's All Right》录于 1954 年 7 月的孟菲斯 Sun 录音室。Presley 演唱 Arthur Crudup 的蓝调歌曲，Scotty Moore 弹电吉他，Bill Black 演奏贝斯。

note.en: Presley, Moore, and Black’s early Sun sides are a key case in how 1950s rock’n’roll formed—drawing on blues, country, and R&B rather than one single source.
note.zh: Presley、Moore 和 Black 在 Sun 的早期录音，是 1950 年代摇滚乐形成过程中的重要案例。这里的声音同时受到 blues、country 和 R&B 的影响，很难归结为单一音乐来源。

note.en: Early regular collaborators on records and shows. Moore and Black left Presley’s team in 1958. Not the 1969 TCB Band.
note.zh: Presley 的早期固定合作阵容。Scotty Moore、Bill Black 和 D.J. Fontana 参与这一时期的录音与现场演出。Moore 和 Black 于 1958 年离开 Presley 的团队。
